eligibility: Advanced clear-cell renal cell carcinoma: first line or after one cytokine, without previous VEGF/mTOR-targeted treatment
Adequate organ and haematological function; source exclusions and prior-treatment criteria must be checked.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
Regimen-specific exclusions encoded in the assessment

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current source-specific support plan; verify local prescription.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for oral SACT
premedication: No routine premedication is required. Confirm that you understand the seven-day break and have the correct capsule strength.
other_support: Keep a dated dosing calendar and blood-pressure record if requested. Contact the team for persistent diarrhoea, reduced intake, severe tiredness or painful palms/soles. Tell the team before surgery; restart after a break for surgery requires a healing review.

treatment_phases.name: 21 days on / 7 days off

administration.notes: Swallow whole; one capsule daily for 21 days followed by seven days off.

treatment_phases.label: 1340 microgram daily on days 1–21, then 7 days off
treatment_phases.summary: Continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity, with individual prescribing review.

baseline: Confirm the clear-cell diagnosis and previous treatments. Full blood count, kidney and liver tests, calcium, magnesium, potassium, thyroid tests, blood pressure, urine protein and a heart tracing (ECG).
regular: Full blood count, kidney and liver tests, thyroid tests, blood pressure and urine protein regularly. Repeat heart tracing and electrolytes periodically and when symptoms or interacting medicines warrant it.
monitoring.disease_monitoring: Symptoms and scans are interpreted together. Your consultant sets imaging timing according to the treatment plan; this regimen does not mandate a universal three-month scan interval.
